name: Hilal Çalışkan
bio_fr:
Hilal Çalışkan was born in Sydney, Australia, and completed her education in Business and Economics at the University of Sydney. Although she worked extensively with charcoal and oil painting for many years, she has been producing professional-level works using the alcohol ink technique since 2020. She can be described as the first artist in Turkey to employ this technique within her own original artistic practice.
Following her Horse Whisperer series, she introduced her new series titled “Checkmate” (Şah Mat) to art lovers in 2024.
Through her participation in numerous group exhibitions and art fairs both in Turkey and internationally, she has successfully introduced this distinctive artistic language and attracted significant attention. She currently lives and continues her artistic practice in Istanbul.

manifesto_fr:
Checkmate Series | The Story of the Knight

“Checkmate does not come from the strongest piece,
but from the move no one accounted for.”
“The fate of those who do not move in straight lines.”

On the chessboard, everyone looks forward.
The Rook moves straight,
the Bishop watches the diagonals,
the Queen wants to control everything.

But the Knight
is the only piece that follows the rules
while not truly belonging to them.

It does not move straight.
It does not walk the expected path.
The Knight moves through the system’s blind spots.

The Knight is not there to protect the King,
but to disrupt the game.

While all eyes are on the Queen,
the Knight waits in silence.

And at the right moment
—with a single move—
it changes the fate of the game.

That is why Checkmate
is not a loud victory.
